introduction: Martina travels with her mother to Villa Mercedes, the city where her mother's family lives. After twelve years of absence he is reunited with his cousins; They do not see each other since they were children, they don't t feel that they know each other, they grew apart. Their mothers are estranged by problems with the family marble onyx company. The youngest of the family are at a key moment in their lives, in crisis with their future and seeing their family estranged does not help them. A tragedy unites them and will make them have to be together, live a trip and get to know each other again.
